description: The twelve main meteor showers seen from Poland for the next twelve months: activity, maximum (Polish time), ZHR, the best hours on the night of the maximum and whether the moon gets in the way. With a shower (e.g. perseids, geminids, Leonidy) only that one, and for the six main ones its night in each of the 18 cities.

lang.description: Language of the answer: pl (default) or en

shower.description: One shower: quadrantids, lyrids, etaAquariids, deltaAquariids, perseids, draconids, orionids, southernTaurids, northernTaurids, leonids, geminids, ursids (or its Polish or English name)
